rules.statement: A grantee of land under the Land Development Ordinance transfers the land to a person without obtaining the prior written consent of the Government Agent as required by section 42, the transfer is null and void and does not have the effect of passing any right or title to the transferee.
rules.supporting_quote: Where a grantee of land under the Land Development Ordinance transfers the land to a person without obtaining the prior written consent of the Government Agent as required by section 42, the transfer is null and void and does not have the effect of passing any right or title to the transferee.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 42 of the Land Development Ordinance
